label: RESEARCH ONLY, NOT EVIDENCE (T0457 attempt 2): banded-acceptance VARIANTS (not the frozen rule) on 2D_Case_4, development seeds, L1 only (O004 F2); no proxy pair

banded_acceptance.decision: founder decision 2026-11-17T15:58:20 UTC (O004 state log; D0024's open item, decided in principle; implemented T0457)
banded_acceptance.rule: e004_run.band_fill. After the first draw of every slot (perturb.draw with the allocation and reference_seed, as before), while a band has a deficit: take the next redrawable slot in cyclic slot order (config.references order, then perturb.draw's order) whose redraw count is below max_redraws_per_slot; redraw it with perturb.draw(reference, {kind: 1}, redraw_seed(s, slot, pos, n)), the slot keeping its kind (every move type keeps its pair on each reference, compounds stay compounds); accept the new pair only if its geometry is new on that reference and it lies in a band with a deficit, else keep the old pair. A slot is redrawable iff every band its pair is in keeps its minimum without it and (protect_sole_coverer) it is not the only single pair covering its move type on its reference under the 6 % rule. Registration refuses (banded_acceptance_filled) when no slot can be redrawn or max_redraws_total is reached with a deficit. L1 at config.l1.hmax_m is the only quantity consulted (F2); the proxy pair counts toward the bands and is never redrawn. Every redraw is recorded (registration.json banded_acceptance.log: slot, seed, parameters, r_L1, accepted, reason; redraws: perturb.draw's internal rejections with move type, reference, class, exception type and message)
banded_acceptance.bands_meaning: at least span.n_below pairs below span.below and at least n_at_or_above_upper at or above span.upper_end (both read from O004's span sentence), a pair counting for a band only if it is in it at both frequencies. The lower end is not a band: the l1_span check still requires min r <= span.lower_end (0.75 until the founder amends O004)
banded_acceptance.limits_meaning: fixed by T0457 before the development simulation was run (research/o004_f7/band_sim_case4.json reports the redraws a fill needed, so the founder can set them); each redraw costs two L1 solves (seconds)
banded_acceptance.statistics_note: with the rule the registered sample is drawn from the sealed seed but conditioned on the bands, so the zero-failure bounds describe the band-conditioned population of re-layouts, not a simple random sample of the rules' draws

l1.hmax_fine_meaning: reviews T0447 / T0448 item 2 (T0457): the near-threshold flag uses the larger of |r_hmax - r_check| and the three-level estimate |r_4mm - r_1mm| + gci_capped(r_4mm, r_2mm, r_1mm) of the gate value's mesh error (reported)
l1.meaning: the F4 gates and the coverage rule are decided on L1 at hmax_m (its default mesh; deterministic, frozen; L1 is not the tool under test). Review T0441 measured ratio shifts up to about 0.005 between 4, 2 and 1 mm, so the ratios at hmax_check_m are reported beside every gate value, and every value within max(near_threshold_abs, |r_hmax - r_check|) of a span or coverage threshold, or on its other side at hmax_check_m, is flagged (reported, not checked)
